input.prompt: Retrieve the structure of alpha-quartz SiO2 from the Materials Project database with mp-6930 as the Materials Project ID and save it in the LAMMPS data format. Use 'full' as atom style. Perform energy minimisation using the reaxff potential and use conjugate gradient as the minimiser, with force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 1e-10, maximum iterations of 1e+5 and maximum evaluations of 1e+5. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions, use real units, full atom style, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Then, run NPT simulations with timestep of 0.001 femtosecond using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat at 0 atm pressure and 300 K temperature with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10000 steps. As the final output, give the density of the system in g/cm^3 units. This is a large simulation, hence multiple CPU cores are recommended.
